options.draft_text: Let's review the NSFW cutoff together. A QA tutor has asked about suggestive-content handling in two threads, including SAFETY-1342. In that task's thread, a QA tutor and a tutor describe the language as suggestive; the QA tutor says it is never explicit, and the tutor cannot tell which policy threshold applies. Another QA tutor asks whether the quoted passage is explicit or merely suggestive. Please bring the relevant passages and any applicable threshold guidance so we can compare the cases and establish the handling to use.

options.label: Post a reminder
options.instruction: Post a linked request in the two threads for the relevant passages and applicable NSFW guidance, keeping the cutoff open until the guidance is confirmed.
options.why: A written request connects the unanswered questions and gathers the context needed for clarification without requiring a meeting or treating an unknown cutoff as settled.
